A.formulation_name: A: interference-modulation index (grounded holographic impedance surface)
A.mathematical_reference: Fong, Colburn, Ottusch, Visher, Sievenpiper, 'Scalar and Tensor Holographic Artificial Impedance Surfaces,' IEEE Trans. Antennas Propag., vol. 58, no. 10, pp. 3212-3221, 2010 (source_registry.json 'fong2010', already cited in Phase 8B); the standard reflection-coefficient/impedance-boundary relation Zs = eta0(1+Gamma)/(1-Gamma) (textbook, 'impedance_boundary_relation').
assumptions: grounded modulated-impedance boundary (|Gamma|=1, purely reactive Zs)
monopole-launched cylindrical guided surface wave as the reference field
surface-wave propagation constant k_swg known from a dispersion analysis
incompatibilities: this project's solver has no ground plane (phase8b.conventions.NO_GROUND_PLANE)
this project's solver has no surface-wave dispersion solver (phase8b.conventions.SURFACE_WAVE_DISPERSION_IMPLEMENTED = False)
A.implementation_status: MATHEMATICALLY DEFINED, NUMERICALLY IMPLEMENTED (phase8b.holographic_modulation), ARCHITECTURE INCOMPATIBLE
A.architecture_evidence: topology_audit.ground_plane = 'ABSENT': context['substrate'] = {'name': 'Rogers RT/Duroid 5880', 'eps_r': 2.2, 'tan_delta': 0.0009, 'thickness_m': 0.001575} (one dielectric layer, not a stack terminated in a conductor); context['metal'] = {'model': 'pec'} (a patterned PEC *sheet at z=0*, i.e. a finite scatterer, not a continuous ground plane); no 'ground' key exists anywhere in the context dict (checked: False); `config.py`/`materials.py`/`geometry.py`/`periodic_bc.py` contain zero occurrences of 'ground' (grep-verified) -- the config schema cannot express a ground plane at all. README.md 'Assumptions' item 2: 'No ground plane, no superstrate' (Phase 1, unchanged through Phase 7).

B.mathematical_reference: Standard reflectarray phase-hologram design equation (phase-conjugate/phase-difference hologram): required_phase = wrap(arg(E_obj) - arg(E_ref)); textbook reflectarray antenna design (e.g. Huang & Encinar, 'Reflectarray Antennas,' Wiley-IEEE Press, 2007 -- standard reference for phase-only reflectarray unit-cell synthesis; already implemented, unmodified, as phase8b.holographic_modulation.phase_difference_hologram).
assumptions: each unit cell's normal-incidence reflection phase alone reproduces the locally required phase shift (local periodic approximation)
the reflected field is the physically radiating one (reflective architecture)
B.implementation_status: MATHEMATICALLY DEFINED, NUMERICALLY IMPLEMENTED, ARCHITECTURE COMPATIBILITY UNVALIDATED (Phase 8B/8C)

C.mathematical_reference: The identical kernel as B (phase8b.holographic_modulation.phase_difference_hologram uses only arg(E_ref)/arg(E_obj), independent of which physical wave carries the radiated field), applied to a transmitarray-style architecture (e.g. Huang & Encinar, op. cit., Ch. 8, 'Transmitarray Antennas'): the reference wave transmits through the surface and the far side carries the shaped object wave.
assumptions: each unit cell's normal-incidence transmission phase alone reproduces the locally required phase shift (local periodic approximation)
the transmitted field is the physically radiating one (transmissive architecture)
C.implementation_status: MATHEMATICALLY DEFINED, NUMERICALLY IMPLEMENTED, ARCHITECTURE COMPATIBILITY UNVALIDATED (Phase 8B/8C)

D.mathematical_reference: Minimum-Frobenius-norm solution of the underdetermined local relation E_obj(x,y) = T(x,y) . E_ref(x,y) for a 2x2 (or scalar) T: T = outer(E_obj, conj(E_ref)) / |E_ref|^2 (direct linear-algebra derivation, documented in control_response.py; the same tensor-surface generalization Fong et al. 2010's title already names ('Scalar AND TENSOR Holographic Artificial Impedance Surfaces'), applied here to a scattering operator rather than a grounded impedance tensor).
assumptions: the required local transfer operator is exactly the minimum-norm one consistent with the single observed (E_ref, E_obj) pair at each point -- NOT unique unless E_ref is a genuine 2-component vector at every point
the unit cell's own 2x2 linear-basis S-block (Sxx, Sxy, Syx, Syy) is the measurable quantity that would need to realize T(x,y)
incompatibilities: Phase 8C measured negligible cross-polarization (<1e-6 of incident power) across every one of the 324 cells in the only registered library (phase8c.power_balance.library_power_summary) -- this specific unit-cell family cannot realize a non-diagonal T(x,y), independent of whether the formulation itself is otherwise valid
D.implementation_status: MATHEMATICALLY DEFINED, NUMERICALLY IMPLEMENTED (control_response.generalized_transfer_operator), LIBRARY DATA INSUFFICIENT
D.architecture_evidence: library-mean cross-polarized power: R_cross=8.44e-33, T_cross=1.03e-32 (threshold 1e-06) -- this unrotated rectangular-patch family does not realize a measurable polarization-converting response.
